description: This is a Flutter widget class for the 'HomeScreen' of a journal app. It manages state, UI layout, navigation for creating and editing entries, search and filtering functionality, and interaction with journal entries.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main home screen of the journal app, providing entry list display, search, filtering, and navigation to create or edit entries.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class for HomeScreen, managing internal logic, search controller, and UI build method.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the search TextEditingController when the widget is removed.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the EntryFormModal widget to create a new journal entry.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the EntryFormModal widget to edit an existing journal entry.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the HomeScreen, including app bar, list of journal entries, search bar, and other UI elements.

methods.name: _emptyState
methods.description: Returns a widget displayed when there are no journal entries.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state, including setting up search controller listener and initial data load.
